label: Temperature
description: Sampling randomness; omission lets the server choose.

label: Top K
description: Candidate token count; zero disables the filter where supported.

label: Min P
description: Minimum token probability relative to the most likely token.

label: Max output tokens
description: Total generation allowance, including reasoning where the provider shares it.

label: Reasoning effort
description: Model reasoning effort; supported levels depend on the model.

label: Thinking budget
description: Reasoning-only token budget; distinct from total output and physical context.

label: Seed
description: Provider sampling seed; reproducibility is not guaranteed.
